import sys
input = sys.stdin.read

# Read input
data = input().split()
a, b, c = map(int, data)

n = a
m = b
M = c

# Initialize arrays
N = 505
dp = [0] * N
f = [0] * N
d = [[0] * N for _ in range(N)]
fd = [[0] * N for _ in range(N)]
C = [[0] * N for _ in range(N)]

# Compute binomial coefficients
f[0] = 1
for i in range(n + 1):
    C[i][0] = 1
    C[i][i] = 1
    for j in range(1, i):
        C[i][j] = (C[i - 1][j] + C[i - 1][j - 1]) % M

# Compute f and dp arrays
for i in range(1, n + 1):
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        f[i] = (f[i] + f[j - 1] * f[i - j] % M * C[i - 1][j - 1] % M * (i + 1)) % M
        s = 0
        for k in range(1, i + 1):
            s += abs(k - j)
        dp[i] = (dp[i] + dp[j - 1] * f[i - j] % M * C[i - 1][j - 1] % M * (i + 1) +
                 f[j - 1] * dp[i - j] % M * C[i - 1][j - 1] % M * (i + 1) +
                 s * f[j - 1] % M * f[i - j] % M * C[i - 1][j - 1]) % M

# Compute fd and d arrays
fd[0][0] = 1
for i in range(1, n + 1):
    for j in range(0, min(m, i) + 1):
        fd[i][j] = fd[i - 1][j]
        d[i][j] = d[i - 1][j]
        for k in range(1, j + 1):
            prev_fd = fd[i - k - 1][j - k] if i - k - 1 >= 0 else 1
            prev_d = d[i - k - 1][j - k] if i - k - 1 >= 0 else 0
            fd[i][j] = (fd[i][j] + prev_fd * f[k] % M * C[j][k]) % M
            d[i][j] = (d[i][j] + ((prev_fd * dp[k] + prev_d * f[k]) % M * C[j][k])) % M

# Output the result
print((d[n][m] % M + M) % M)
